blocking_caveats: The v11 symbolic registry parity is not a materialized registry because all schema and registry digests remain null.
The universal subrecord rule conflicts with digest-bearing endpoint, payload, event, operation, saturation, control, and replay subrecords, and several local digest preimages are absent.

The terminal stream dependency is acyclic only under an unstated shortened-frame payload-length convention; terminal emission, owner mapping, candidate-cap, replay-failure, and exhaustion predicates remain incomplete.

Phase-1 target indexing is separated from A_p, but source bytes, source semantics, path/commit binding, curve-table identity, and helper/matrix reconstruction do not yet close the fixed-advice quantifier.
Provider and execution refusal gates are correct, but the edge implementation, witness equations, signature preimage, artifact/mirror domains, and path policy are absent.
Event populations, primitive equations, local event digest preimages, output byte accounting, and advice/work memory lifetimes are not uniquely recomputable.
The HNF rule has a pivot-order and signed-division ambiguity; saturation chaining and output witness predicates remain undefined.
Paired replay has widths but no exact normalization/shared-byte semantics, null mutation law, or identity-bit equality predicate.
C-pair and synthetic controls are correctly invalid while missing, but their future generators, initial states, and complete table preimages are not bound.
The incumbent is correctly pending and no comparison is admissible; its no-fixed-advice model is not matched to the successor fixed-advice scope and break_even_q has no equation.
